groups.name: Grouping threshold removal
groups.rationale: Removes the configurable threshold that skipped small diffs from grouping, making the model group every diff of two or more files.

groups.name: Documentation updates
groups.rationale: Updates spec and skill descriptions to reflect that only one-file diffs skip grouping, and replaces `groupingThreshold` with `feedbackLog` as the example optional config key.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
